title: Describe Data by Mean Absolute Deviation
focus: Use MAD to describe average distance

items.stem: What does the Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) tell us about a set of data?
choices: The difference between the largest and smallest numbers
The average distance each data point is from the mean
The middle value when data is arranged in order
The sum of all the values in the data set

items.stem: A student recorded the number of books read by 5 classmates in a month: 3, 7, 5, 9, and 6. What is the approximate Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) of this data set?
Select all the statements that correctly describe the Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD). Show or explain your work.
choices: MAD measures how spread out the data points are from the mean.
A smaller MAD means the data values are closer to the mean.
MAD is calculated by averaging the absolute differences between each data point and the mean.

items.stem: The scores on a math test were 80, 85, 90, 75, and 95. Calculate the Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) of these scores. Show or explain your work.
